webster.text: To stop; to cease to act or proceed; to forbear; with from; as, he desisted from his purpose; let us desist.

example.quote: BLOODWORTH wished that gentlemen would desist from making personal reflections.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. BLOODWORTH, July 26, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
